usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added `fee <appointment>`, which prints e.g. `a1 visit fee 60.00` and changes nothing, and put it in `help` right after `cancel`; all 8 tests pass and the work is committed (`7a41b75`).
For clinicians with no fee in `docs/visit-fees.md` (e.g. k2), `fee` now refuses with `error: no visit fee listed for <clinician>` instead of the old silent 0; that wording is mine, so I recorded it as new decision DEC-W-6, which the gate has not yet authorized.
Open questions for Finance are in `.work/report.json`: what `fee` should show for those clinicians, and how changes to the fee list should reach the hard-coded fees in `Rules.visitFee`.
OUTCOME: completed
